definitions.explanation: A form of government in which power is concentrated in a single individual or a small group, without meaningful democratic checks. Decisions are made unilaterally without the consent of the governed.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独裁制|どくさいせい}だ。
{独裁制|どくさいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう}→言論の自由：17047_genronnojiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Under a dictatorship, there is no freedom of speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}→抗議：12807_kougi⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{独裁制|どくさいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The dictatorship collapsed due to citizen protests.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (dictatorship, autocracy) + ⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (system). Carries a strongly negative connotation in modern Japanese usage, implying oppressive and undemocratic governance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独裁制|どくさいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to impose a dictatorship
- {独裁制|どくさいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for a dictatorship to collapse
- ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧{独裁制|どくさいせい}: military dictatorship
- {独裁制|どくさいせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{民主化|みんしゅか}→民主化：13230_minshuka⟧: democratization from dictatorship

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{独裁者|どくさいしゃ}→独裁者：15406_dokusaisha⟧: dictator
- ⟦{君主制|くんしゅせい}→君主制：21776_kunshusei⟧: monarchy
- {民主制|みんしゅせい}: democracy (contrasting system)
- {全体主義|ぜんたいしゅぎ}: totalitarianism
